map.PID 控制器输出计算器：输入比例、积分、微分系数与误差信号，按 PID 控制律: PID controller output calculator: enter proportional, integral and derivative gains plus the error signal to compute the controller output in real time following the PID control law, for tuning closed-loop control parameters in robotics.
map.P/I/D 三项合成。: The P, I and D terms combine.
map.：ki=kd=0 → u=2，稳态有静差；加 I 消除、D 抑制超调。: ki = kd = 0 -> u = 2, with a steady-state offset; adding I removes it and D suppresses overshoot.
map.由转动惯量与角加速度求所需扭矩: Derive the Required Torque from Moment of Inertia and Angular Acceleration
map.角度 = (脉宽 − 最小) / (最大 − 最小) × 180°: Angle = (pulse width - min) / (max - min) x 180 degrees
map.由每转步数求步距角: Derive the step angle from steps per revolution
map.误差积分累积；ep 为上一拍误差，用于 D 项差分 (e−ep)/dt。: Integrated error accumulation; ep is the previous step's error, used for the D term difference (e - ep)/dt.
map.大误差长期积分易饱和，需抗积分饱和限幅。: Large errors saturate the integrator over time, so anti-windup clamping is needed.
